scope: three WSI-linked annotated ROI feasibility probe, not full-WSI or clinical validation
selection: First lexicographic ROI per first3case IDs with RGB/mask/CSV visible in all three initial public GoogleDrive folder pages; no prediction-based selection. Pages are capped at50entries, not a full dataset inventory.
inference: native ROI output1024x1024,128px no_overlap,current frozen model pipeline
evaluation_scope: Intersection of FOV rectangle, tissue-channel nonzero, nucleus classes1..7 or9; exclude ambiguous8, unlabeled0, and inclusive rectangles from CSV before any score; preserve ignored counts.
metrics: binary foreground Dice/IoU/precision/recall in valid pixels only; seam bands128px with8px halfwidth intersectvalidmask; perROI then macro3ROI
coordinate_check: Compare server region from encoded level0bounds at1024output against providedRGB; recordcorrelation,MAE,phase-shift and visually inspectoverlay; no label/predictiondriven alignment or scoreselection
scale_caveat: EffectiveMPP derives from serverlevel0MPP*bboxwidth/1024; check against advertised0.25MPP without assuming match.
